reviewed_by: Claude review of chat import hoisting
reason: test_nebula3_runtime_has_no_conditional_import_fallbacks failed on main because ChatService rebuilt tool components on resume with `from .skill_catalog import ...` inside a try block. chat.py now imports skill_catalog (SkillSelection, SkillSnapshot, discover_skills, native_skill_roots, skill_instructions, skill_resource_components, snapshot_skill) and application_model.tools.standalone_components at module level and drops every function-local copy; neither module imports chat, and the Core build already uses --collect-submodules nebula.v3, so build_nebula_core.py needs no hidden import. Selected tests cover the packaging guard in test_packaging.py, skill selection and snapshots in test_skill_catalog.py, chat preparation with skills and tools in test_chat.py, and the paused-turn tool-component rebuild in test_chat_tool_loop.py.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: only Python import placement changed, with no API, UI, origin, cookie or socket behavior change. No full suites.
